title: Collins sends the 1933 band home and Armstrong recontacts him
summary: Collins booked Armstrong in France and sent the band to Chicago; on returning, Armstrong contacted Randolph and McKendrick.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Yeah. Well, at this time, Johnny Collins keeps coming in and out of this story. I read somewhere that he was responsible for the breakup of the '33 band.
That's right. He booked Louis in France and sent the boys home.
Sent the boys back to Chicago.
And then, when Louis came back from France, came to Chicago and then contacted you again.
He came back -- yes, he contacted Mike McKendrick and myself.
